svg.title: Production incident response agent reference architecture
svg.desc: A four-boundary illustrative reference design showing read-only diagnosis, versioned hypotheses, evaluator challenge, human terminal authority, narrow idempotent change, service authority, recovery verification, rollback, abstention, and manual control.
